entities.name: Arathoxia
entities.description: A city-state of Corondor at the delta of the Tenamis River, once the world's richest, destroyed in the Fall of Arathoxia.

entities.name: Grand Sultan of Arathoxia
entities.description: Ruler of Arathoxia until its fall.

entities.name: Scarlet Vizier
entities.description: Ruler of the Mansion of the Scarlet Domain who helped build Arathoxia.

entities.name: Liana of Minorad
entities.description: Helped build Arathoxia while in the vizier's servitude.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: Scion of House Carthalion who grew up in the city.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Ravaged Arathoxia with the Chaos Orb in 4195 AR.

entities.name: Chaos Orb
entities.description: Artifact used by Ravidel to cause the Fall of Arathoxia.

entities.name: General Yorgo
entities.description: Former companion of Jared who defended the city.

entities.name: House Bikov
entities.description: One of the five houses, lost in the Fall.

entities.name: House Kavrel
entities.description: One of the five houses, destroyed in the Fall.

entities.name: House Khone
entities.description: One of the five houses; its Lord survived the Fall.

entities.name: House Scarlet
entities.description: One of the five houses, still technically active through Jared Carthalion.

entities.name: House Verdenth
entities.description: One of the five houses, destroyed in the Fall.

entities.name: Fall of Arathoxia
entities.description: The ravaging of the city by Ravidel.

entities.name: Planeswalker War
entities.description: War during which Yorgo defended the city.

events.summary: Arathoxia is built with the aid of Liana of Minorad and the Scarlet Vizier.
